MINUTES
  MALIBU CITY COUNCIL
  SPECIAL MEETING
  SEPTEMBER 27, 2023
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  6:00 P.M.

The following meeting was held pursuant to AB 361 and teleconferenced from various
locations during the coronavirus disease (COVID-19) pandemic.

MEETING CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Uhring called the meeting to order at 6:00 p.m.

ROLL CALL

  The following persons were recorded in attendance by the Recording Secretary:

  PRESENT: Mayor Steve Uhring; Mayor Pro Tem Doug Stewart; and Councilmembers
  Paul Grisanti, Marianne Riggins, and Bruce Silverstein

  ALSO PRESENT: Trevor Rusin, Interim City Attorney; Steve McClary, City Manager;
  Joseph Toney, Assistant City Manager; Alexis Brown, Deputy City Manager; Kelsey
  Pettijohn, City Clerk; Kristin Riesgo, Community Services Director; Yolanda Bundy,
  Environmental Sustainability Director; Richard Mollica, Planning Director; Susan Duefias,
  Public Safety Director; Rob DuBouX, Public Works Director; Rob Houston, Interim
  Deputy City Manager, and Jason Lawrence, Deputy City Clerk.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Mayor Pro Tem Stewart led the Pledge of Allegiance.

REPORT ON POSTING OF AGENDA

  Deputy City Clerk Lawrence reported that the agenda for the meeting was properly posted
  on September 21, 2023.

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

MOTION  Councilmember Grisanti moved, and Councilmember Riggins seconded a motion
  to approve the agenda. The question was called, and the motion carried
  unanimously.

PUBLIC COMMENT ON WORKSHOP

  Mayor Uhring opened the floor to public comment. As there were no speakers
  present, he closed public comment.

  1i  ITEM 1  NEW BUSINESS

  A.  Strategic Priority Proj ect Update and Final Proj ect List Approval
  Recommended Action: 1) Approve the Strategic Priority Proj ect list for Fiscal Year
  (FY) 2023 -24; and 2) Create a Malibu Culture Ad Hoc Committee to work with the
  Malibu Culture Priority Proj ect team, and 3) Approve the recommended list of
  employee benefit items.

  Steve McClary presented the staff report.

  The Council discussed the matter and directed questions to staff.

  MOTION  Councilmember Silverstein moved to:
  1) approve the Strategic Priority Project list for Fiscal Year (FY) 2023 -24;
  2) direct the City Council Policy Review Ad Hoc Committee to work with the
  Malibu Culture Priority Proj ect team;
  3) direct the City Manager to provide project updates every two months at City
  Council meetings;
  4) direct staff to set the next Strategic Workshop for March 2024 to revisit and
  update the Priority List;
  5) approve the recommended list of employee benefit items, directing staff to:
  a) explore an alternate Flaming Commission meeting day;
  b) examine options for an earlier start time for City Council meetings and
  V rearrangement of the agenda order;
  c) develop a plan for service coverage to support closure of City Hall during
  winter break at the end of December;
  d) create a car stipend for staff unable to participate in hybrid remote
  workday option; and
  e) add Juneteenth as an official City Holiday; and

  FRIENDLY AMENDMENT
  Councilmember Riggins seconded the motion and moved to amend the motion to
  direct staff to bring back an item for adoption of the Juneteenth holiday as soon as
  possible.

  The amendment was accepted by the maker of the motion.

  The question was called, and the amended motion carried unanimously.

  ADJOURNMENT

  At 7:31 p.m., Mayor Uhring moved, and Councilmember Riggins seconded a
  motion to adj ourn the meeting. The motion carried unanimously.
